reasons.edited-copy: A copy WordPress made of a picture that is shown, or the original of an edited one that is shown (resized, edited, or cropped for the header or site icon)
reasons.duplicate: The same file or photo, uploaded again; the other upload is shown
reasons.linked-as-text: Only linked from a page’s text, not shown as a picture
reasons.theme-only: Shown by the site’s theme (header, logo, background), not in a post
reasons.hidden-post: Uploaded to a post or page that is a draft, private or trashed
reasons.burst: A near-identical shot of a picture that is shown (taken a moment later)
reasons.not-placed: Uploaded to a published post or page, never placed in it
reasons.unattached: In the media library, attached to no post
reasons.closed: Closed without login: attached to no post, or to a draft, private or trashed one (the site’s WXR export tells which)
